en: Instead, Elsin did the unexpected. He built an entirely new city on the southern shore of Lake Efnian -- Kaluen. A glorious capitol was constructed, with monuments and parks to rival even the ancient works of the Kandra. All things good and true flow from Aramon to Elsin's city-by-the-lake; the people enjoy the finest goods and foodstuffs carted in each day to be sold in the many markets. Kaluen is truly the marvel of all Aramon.
zh: 艾尔辛偏不按常理来。他在艾夫尼亚湖南岸另起一座新城——卡鲁恩。都城盖得气派，碑刻与园林足以同坎德兰人的古作比肩。凡阿拉蒙的好东西、真东西，都往艾尔辛这座湖畔之城流；每天大车小车运来上等货物与吃食，在各处集市上开卖，百姓只管享用。卡鲁恩确是全阿拉蒙的奇观。

en: Narmer is perhaps the most cultured of Aramon's major cities, perhaps reflecting the influence of the powerful House of Dernhest. Sages and mages of many different outlooks often gather in the common rooms of Narmer inns, and discussion of Aramon and its place among the Four Realms is often the norm. A sense of closeness exists among the people of Narmer and their cousins across the lake in Kaluen, and marriages between the two cities' merchant families and nobility is not uncommon.
zh: 纳默尔大约是阿拉蒙几座大城里最讲文教的一座，想来与势力雄厚的德恩赫斯特家不无关系。各持己见的贤者与法师常聚在纳默尔客栈的大堂里，谈阿拉蒙、谈它在四大疆域中的位置，几乎成了日常。纳默尔人与湖对岸卡鲁恩的亲戚素来亲近，两城商人世家与贵族之间结亲，也不算稀奇。

en: The White City takes it names from the white stone that is the backbone of the city's buildings and fortifications, each a thing quite pleasing to the eye. Ralum is home to families of extraordinary stonemasons, and their work is truly a thing to behold. Their skills handed down from parent to child over many generations, the masons of Ralum raised high the mighty walls of Kaluen, and perhaps saved their best work for their own city by the water.
zh: 白城得名于那一色白石：屋宇城墙都拿它做骨架，看着样样悦目。拉卢姆出过几代了不起的石匠，手艺代代相传，活计真是好看。卡鲁恩那圈高墙便是他们砌起来的；而最好的一手，怕是留给了自家这座水边城。

en: Our journey's end came days later, with our leader's triumphant return home to the piers and streets of Lendra. The return was marred by the fact that Captain Lahar at first simply refused to relinquish the ship's wheel to Horvino, who wished to demonstrate his newly won prowess as a sailor and navigator. Lahar claimed that the shifting winds at this time of year made the passage into the bay somewhat difficult, and with the possibility of reefs or sandbars below, perhaps dangerous, as well.
zh: 又走了几天，行程到了尽头，领袖凯旋回到伦德拉的码头与街巷。偏有一点扫兴：拉哈尔船长起初说什么也不肯把舵交出去，霍尔维诺却正想显显新学的操船与领航本事。船长只推说这个时节风向不定，进湾的航道本就难走，水下再有暗礁沙洲，说不定还危险。

en: But the Hand ... Takkawaw's Hand calls me. The map feels hot and heavy in my satchel - I have committed it to memory, lines burned in my head. The tribal elder, Uary, has offered me escort through the southern Tethrian. Promised me escort to foot of the Haemus Mountains and the trailhead that leads to Ulasem. It's a trail they use for pilgrimages to honor Thirsha's throne in Ulasem.
zh: 可那只手……塔卡瓦瓦之手在唤我。地图揣在行囊里，烫手似的沉；上头的线我已背得滚瓜烂熟，一笔一划都烙在脑子里。部落长老乌阿里答应派人护我穿过泰斯里安南部，一直送到海穆斯山脚下、通往乌拉塞姆的山道口。他们朝圣去乌拉塞姆拜瑟莎王座，走的就是这条路。

en: A Verunan merchant vessel had put in to the city for fresh water before heading to Khusra in the south. I called out to the vessel's captain in Lihr's Tongue and shared the story of my predicament. The captain, a man named Moar, took me aboard in exchange for work and I happily set about with the running of lines and scraping of barnacles. Huh. Every Verunan boy is taught ship-skills - I am no different. Only to Khusra, the captain said. Only closer to Ulasem, said I. Closer to the prize. The Hand. The Hand!
zh: 一艘维鲁纳商船为了补淡水停靠此城，随后要南下库希拉。我用里尔语朝船长喊话，把自己的窘境说了一遍。船长名叫莫尔，答应让我上船，条件是干活；我便高高兴兴地料理缆绳、刮起船底的藤壶。哼，维鲁纳家的男孩个个都学过船上本事，我也不例外。「只到库希拉。」船长说。「只求更靠近乌拉塞姆。」我说。离那件宝物更近一点。那只手。那只手！

en: Unfortunately, my master was unable to secure transport to the other Southern Islands - Varro, Greif, Altus and Ettan, the ancestral homes of the Berserkers, those fearsome men of many a Verunan legend. Our leader was kept from these islands partly due to inclement weather and a few unruly ship captains who refused to meet Horvino's traveling requirements. Although merely a scribe, I fail to see how our leader's group of personal minstrels could do anything but help make the journey a joyful one.

en: Athri is quite different in flavor than Caora (indeed, each of the Three Sisters has its own distinctiveness), being heavily forested with fragrant trees of reddish wood. Whereas Vanoc folk remain close to the sea (and therefore "rural," in their own sense), the people of Athri are as cultured and noble as the Lendran folk. The Athri-folk also enjoy a large amount of trade with unnamed lands to the far north; local merchants offer for sale furs from strange beasts, colorful fabrics and weapons of iron and other fine alloys than are not easily found in Darien.
zh: 阿斯里和卡奥拉的气息全然不同（三姐妹岛其实各有各的味道）：这里林木蓊郁，红木树散发着香气。瓦诺克人守着海过日子（按他们自己的说法，算是「乡下人」），阿斯里人却和伦德拉人一样文雅有礼。阿斯里人还同北方那些叫不出名字的地方做大买卖，本地商贩摆出来的，有异兽毛皮、彩色织物，还有铁器和其他上等合金打造的兵器——这些东西在达里恩可不容易见到。

en: Vanir's Breach: The ship's navigator, a woman named Anemone, related a Vidaran legend concerning the Vanir sea. Anemone said that long ago, before the rule of the Kandra, the nations we call Aramon and Zhon were actually parts of a single land, with one people, the Vanir, living there in peace. And in a fit of rage, the god of these people split the land asunder, and the waters rushed in to fill the emptiness.
zh: 瓦尼尔裂隙：船上的领航员是位叫阿内蒙的女子，她讲了个关于瓦尼尔海的维达兰古传说。她说，早在坎德兰人掌权之前，如今叫阿拉蒙和佐恩的两处本是一整块陆地，上头住着同一个和和气气的族群——瓦尼尔人。后来他们的神一怒之下把大地劈开，海水涌进来，填满了那道裂口。

There we were held without food for three days; all we had were each other to cling to, which was cold comfort indeed from the chaos and suffering outside. It was as if we were trapped within the gates of Hell.

en: Meredoc's beauty soon overwhelmed the party, pushing the troublesome time aboard ship out of our minds. Rumored to have been settled by a Kandran wizard of particular might, Meredoc is the largest settlement in the southern islands, sitting astride the major trade route to Aramon. As the closest Verunan settlement to the western lands, it can be said that the people of this island are more like Aramon folk than Verunan. Meredoc's people are a rustic, florid folk, and speak the Verunan tongue with a distinctive, guttural accent. They are also quite religious, likely the result of influence by the noble house of Jatha, which is known for its piety. The worship of both Lihr and Anu, and other lesser gods, is practiced openly.
zh: 梅雷多克的美景很快压过了旅途的烦扰，众人把船上的那些不痛快都抛到了脑后。相传此地由一位法力极强的坎德兰法师所建，是南方群岛最大的聚居地，正扼着通往阿拉蒙的主贸易航线。它也是离西方大陆最近的维鲁纳城镇，因此岛上居民倒更像阿拉蒙人，而不像维鲁纳人。梅雷多克人质朴而热烈，说维鲁纳语时带着特别的喉音；他们还十分虔诚，想来是受以敬神闻名的贾塔贵族家族影响。在这里，里尔、安努以及诸位小神的崇拜都可以公开进行。

en: An interesting note from this region is the Dengland ruins, a series of apparently man-made structures that lie on sandy islands in the river south of Abiad. Perhaps constructed by an earlier people during the Shadowtime, the Dengland ruins are completely covered by the rising Chasul waters in the spring and summer months, and only emerge in fall and winter. It is not known if the ruins were constructed before the river found its present course, or if they are the result of some strange magic. Either way, erosion from the waters and the limited time the ruins are exposed to the light of day hampers any large-scale study.
zh: 这一带有处耐人寻味的登格兰遗迹：阿比亚德以南的河心沙洲上，散着一组明显出自人工的建筑。它们或许建于影子时代的某支先民之手，春夏两季被上涨的查苏尔河水整个淹没，只有秋冬才露出水面。究竟是先有遗迹、后有今日河道，还是某种古怪魔法留下的手笔，已无从考究。无论如何，水流的侵蚀，加上遗迹每年见天光的日子太短，都让大规模的勘察难以展开。

en: In the second year of the Baron's rule, my family joined a small party of neighbors who wished to escape the Leimar lands and crawl out from under the Baron's mailed fist. Our goal was the city of Shekelesh, which lay just to the north at the foot of the Greater Kaf. en: It's going to matter tremendously, no matter what level of prestige you've earned in the Darien Crusades. While it's true that lower ranked players won't earn as many victory points toward the conquering of a territory, your victory could very well be the triggering battle that seals its fate. If you're ferocious in the heat of battle, rising in ranks and stature among your peers, you'll bear the honor (and responsibility) in each battle of wagering a larger amount of victory points when you win, and costing your side more victory points when you lose. Either way, every battle matters.

en: Mt. Pharidon is one of the most recognizable landmarks in Aramon, a conical, snow-capped mountain emerging from the surrounding foothills. It has not been determined if Pharidon is actually a dormant volcano, although bursts of steam are seen to escape from the summit. en: Moar had a sight-glass -- tube of bronze with carved glass at either end that allowed a man to see faraway sights as if they were at the end of your nose. Through the glass, we could see flying shapes ... belching fire ... darting through the city smoke. Wyverns ... flying reptiles like the great dragons ... Harpies worse; even far, far away, their song set my teeth a-grinding.

en: Iapur and Lahun are the only Zhon cities where travelers to this land do not fear for their lives. That is, they do not fear the daylight hours so much, but night brings the sound of leathern wings beating the air and scratch, scratch, scratching on your roof. Make a man shudder. Iapur itself is not much by Verunan or even Aramon standards, just a dock on the lagoon, a few wooden longhouses, an inn without a name.
zh: 佐恩境内，只有伊阿普尔和拉胡恩两座城，外来人不必提着性命过日子。倒也不是说白天就多太平，只是入夜后才听得见皮翼扑打空气的声响，还有屋顶上抓呀、抓呀、抓个不停的动静，叫人脊背发凉。按维鲁纳乃至阿拉蒙的眼光，伊阿普尔本身实在算不得什么：潟湖边一个码头，几排木长屋，一家连招牌都没有的客栈。

en: There were no people to speak of, for Elam was a city of the dead. We passed columns of skeleton soldiers walking clickety-clack in crisp formation. Herds of dead men, their flesh still attached, wandered the alleys. Above, there were reptilian Gargoyles, either flying on leather wings or sitting stone silent on castle walls. Ghost Ships hovered over Lake Dagon, and I saw a demon, I did -- a brick-red monstrosity that carried a wicked blade. I shudder at that memory.
zh: 那里几乎见不到活人——埃兰是座死城。我们经过一列列骷髅兵，咔嗒咔嗒地走着齐整的队列；成群尸身尚带血肉的亡者在巷子里游荡。头顶是蜥蜴似的石像鬼，有的撑着皮翼飞，有的如石雕般一声不响蹲在城墙上。幽灵船悬在达贡湖上；我还真看见了恶魔，砖红色的一头巨物，手里提着柄凶刃。如今想起，我仍要发抖。

en: The Thunor are often called the "Blue Hills" because of their appearance in a hazy evening. The mountains themselves appear older, less spare and rocky, than their counterparts elsewhere. Time has softened their edges, and a great many colorful trees have taken residence among the peaks. Wildlife abounds -- it is said that the Thunor is a place with a profound quantity of birds, bears and elbow room. Many well-worn trails are carved into the northern passes, allowing caravans to wend their way from Abiad to Kaleun each month.
zh: 图诺尔群山常被叫作「蓝丘」，因为暮霭里望去一片青蓝。比起别处的山，它们显得更老，嶙峋的石棱也少些；岁月磨圆了轮廓，峰间倒长满了色彩斑斓的树。野物极多——都说图诺尔的鸟、熊和空旷地儿，样样都富足。北侧山口踩出了一条条旧道，商队每月便顺着这些路，从阿比亚德蜿蜒去往卡鲁恩。

en: Many geographers maintain that the Yniol wood is, in fact, four or five separate forests, and this is borne out by the variance of foliage in different parts of the forest. en: Abiad's reputation is well deserved; the beauty of its parks and temples are well known throughout Aramon, and the skill of Abiad architects is envied far and wide. Outside the city walls, rich farmland abounds, while in the springtime, the hills are carpeted with red heather.

en: The surrounding area is not firmly under the control of any single great house. Instead, dozens of smaller lords control a seemingly countless array of small hamlets and shires. en: The Strait of Geryon: The waters are calm here, but they are the most dangerous of Darien, according to the captain. Only well-armed naval vessels make the passage east to the Sea of Tapas. The Strait is home to sea creatures larger than the northern whales, and creatures of the sky and wind fly north from the Zhon jungles to pluck sailors from the decks of ships. Survive that, and a ship still must avoid pirates from both north and south.
zh: 杰里翁海峡：据船长说，这儿水面平静，却是达里恩最凶险的一段。只有武备齐全的军舰才敢向东穿过去进塔帕斯海。海峡里养着比北方巨鲸还大的海物，天上还有乘风从佐恩丛林北来的东西，能把水手从甲板上叼走。这些都能躲过，船还得提防南北两路的海盗。

en: This dispute was put to the test in the latter half of the reign of Garacaius. Two representatives, Winfrey of Ralum and Dagnir of Kaluen, met 40 leagues north of Laingen to prove their respective theories. Winfrey intended to swim across the Humber. Dagnir planned to merely float in the hopes of demonstrating that the current of the Humber was still more powerful than the tides. Unfortunately, neither scholar was aware of the strong current caused by the spring thaw in the flatlands below Ullin's Fingers. Both were swept out to the Sea of Mannan, never to be seen again. The result of this experiment was inconclusive.
zh: 加拉卡尤斯在位后期，有人想给这场争论做个了断。拉卢姆的温弗莱与卡鲁恩的达格尼尔两位代表，在莱恩根以北 40 里格处碰头，各要证明自己的说法：温弗莱打算横渡亨伯河，达格尼尔只想浮在水上，好证明亨伯的水流依旧强过潮汐。可惜两人都没料到，乌林之指下方平原春雪消融，会催出这般急流。结果双双被卷进曼南海，再无音讯——这场实验到底也没争出个结论。

Harken, they said, hailed from the tribe Uru, a particularly warlike bunch. The I'homazan ruled Lahun in peace, preferring to deal with traders from Veruna and Taros rather than stalk and hunt each meal.

en: The Sea of Tapas: "If ye can make it past the Geryon, the Tapas awaits you," said Captain Lahar. "And then you be surely doomed." First officer Sculpin said at night, the Tapas was black as coal, with no stars in the night sky to guide you. He said other sailors had reported that bands of Tarosian tribesmen lit false signal fires on the shoreline, leading ships to founder on sharp reefs. Other sailors told tales of meeting a tribe called the Kiniket who made their home on the northeastern shores of Zhon. The Kiniket, they said, provided the only safe haven in these parts, a peaceful place of warm, verdant beaches.
zh: 塔帕斯海：「你若过得去杰里昂，塔帕斯就在前头等着你，」拉哈尔船长说，「可那时你也就死定了。」大副斯库平说，入夜后塔帕斯黑得像煤，天上没有一颗星能指引方向。他还说，别的水手报过：塔罗斯部族的人会在岸上点起假信号火，把船引上尖礁撞沉。也有水手讲过一支叫基尼凯特的部族，住在佐恩东北海岸；他们说，这一带只有基尼凯特是安稳的避风港，那里沙滩温暖、草木葱茏，一片太平。

en: It is generally agreed that at least half of Poyser Canal is not a natural waterway. Its method of construction is a subject of much debate. Whether it was one of the Kandran's massive magical works, or the result of back-breaking labor on someone's part is a subject of much debate. Regardless, the canal is a vital route for trade, connecting the capitol city, Kaluen, with the world's sea lanes.
zh: 公认的说法是，波伊瑟运河至少有一半并非天然水道。究竟是坎德兰人某桩宏大的法术工程，还是不知谁一锹一锹硬挖出来的，争到今天也没个定论。不管怎样，这条河是商贸命脉，把都城卡鲁恩接上了四海航路。

The passage would take us northward to the western shores of Karitia, north-by-northwest to Fionbar and Athri, then due west to Vanoc.

en: Now, the nights had always been different, as the walls of the great city were closed, and horror befell those locked outside. "Never go out at night!" I can hear Mother insisting even now. But slowly, not all at once, it seemed Ugarit slipped gradually into the sewer ditches. Grandmother Eder remembers the night-wolf howling outside the city walls growing louder in the summer. I remember the coronation of Baron Leimar, as well as the first executions of those who spoke out against he and his clan. I remember skies the color of fireplace ashes. I remember voices talking from the sewers, beckoning. I remember men marching from the Academy, never to be seen again by their families.
zh: 那时候，夜晚向来与白日不同：大城的城门一关，被锁在城外的人便要遭遇不测。「千万别在夜里出门！」母亲这句叮嘱，我至今仍听得见。可乌加里特并非一夜之间沦落，而是缓缓地、一点一点滑进了下水道的沟渠里。祖母艾德记得，夏夜里城墙外夜狼的嚎叫越来越响。我记得莱玛尔男爵的加冕礼，也记得第一批因直言反对他及其氏族而被处死的人。我记得天空是壁炉灰烬的颜色。记得下水道里有人说话，声声招唤。记得学院里列队走出的男人，从此再没被家人见过。

en: The Bay of Mist: Not mist, but steam, gives these waters their name, said Captain Lahar. A river of blood-red lava pours west from the slopes of Mt. Angvir, and where the lava meets the water, a great quantity of steam is produced. As a bosun's mate in earlier days, Lahar's ship put in at northern cove to take on a horrible cargo: slaves captured in Taros' inner lands. "Rough trade, that," said Lahar. "Not for me. I jumped ship as soon as we returned to Veruna."
zh: 迷雾湾：拉哈尔船长说，给这片水起名的是蒸汽，不是雾。一条血红的熔岩从安格维山山坡向西灌进海里，熔岩入水处腾起漫天白汽。早年间拉哈尔当水手长副手时，他所在的船曾泊进北边的小湾，装上一船吓人的货：从塔罗斯内陆掳来的奴隶。「那买卖脏，」拉哈尔说，「我干不来。船一回到维鲁纳，我就跳船上岸了。」

en: A player can hold a ranked status in all four sides; however, players hold an active rank (and rank icon) for only one race at any time, so choose well whom you will serve. An Aramon player with a high ranking who switches to playing as Zhon will maintain their Aramon rank only until they are promoted to an equal rank in Zhon. In order to regain their Aramon icon as the active icon, they must meet the conditions of promotion to a higher Aramon ranking than the last achieved Aramon ranking they obtained before converting to a different race. Needless to say, the higher your ranking upon departure from fealty to a particular nation, the harder it becomes to regain the confidence and trust of that nation upon your return.
zh: 玩家可以在四个阵营里都保有排名，但同一时间只有一个种族的排名（及排名图标）处于生效状态，所以效力于谁，务必想清楚。一名在阿拉蒙排名颇高的玩家改投佐恩后，其阿拉蒙排名只保留到他在佐恩晋升到同等阶位为止。若想让阿拉蒙图标重新成为生效图标，他必须晋升到比改换阵营前所获的阿拉蒙阶位更高一级。不用说，离开某个国家时阶位越高，日后想重新赢得它的信任，也就越难。

en: There are two ranks in Clash of Nations: The first, numerical rank, is a breakdown of a player's performance in battle against opponents, taking into account both his current rank and the rank of the opponent. Players are ordered by numerical ranking as they appear in the ladders. The second, iconic ranking, is achieved by meeting pre-set criteria to advance in stature. Requirements to achieve iconic ranking are listed below. Both the numerical and iconic ranks are displayed in the player's personal profile. Details of rank requirements can be found in the following articles: Aramon Promotion, Taros Promotion, Veruna Promotion, Zhon Promotion.

en: The journal consists of 42 leaves of a stiff, scroll-like material that is unknown among the Verunan islands. Most of the leaves are covered on both sides with intelligible letters of black ink that correspond to the characters of the High Speech. The leaves themselves, colored a dull yellow, seem to be composed of some kind of vegetable fiber. They are as thin as scroll-paper, but they are quite durable and shed water like a duck's feathers. While the tale they contain is certainly astonishing, it is this monk's humble wish that the Order of Letters could locate the creators of the leaves, as the material would be invaluable to our work.
zh: 这本手记共 42 叶，用的是维鲁纳群岛上从未见过的硬质卷轴状材料。多数叶面正反两面都写满黑墨的清晰字迹，与「高等语」的字母相合。叶色暗黄，看得出是某种植物纤维所制；薄如卷轴纸，却格外结实，还能像鸭羽一般拒水。册中所记固然惊人，但贫僧只有一个卑微的愿望：愿文字修会寻到造出这些叶子的人——这样的材料，于我们的抄写之事实在是无价之宝。

Visions of future I see ... I know now that the story is true. But visions are not always good ones. For in the stone now, I can see myself. My own face, but with eyes unseeing. Unblinking.

en: The Kandra is a forest primarily of oak and yew, a happy coincidence for the Guilds of Fletchers and Bowyers, who turn Kandran wood into the finest weapons in the land. The ocean breezes and fine soil combine in just the right way to produce yew that is strong, yet flexible, for long bows. The oak branches are quite dense, perfect for straight and sturdy arrows. Kandra Forest arrows are easily recognizable from their blue fletching, and it is said that each will find 10 targets in its lifetime.
zh: 坎德拉森林以橡树和紫杉为主，这对箭匠行会与弓匠行会来说是天赐的巧合——他们把坎德拉的木料做成全国最精良的武器。海风与沃土配得恰到好处，长出的紫杉既坚韧又有弹性，正合做长弓；橡树枝干极密，最宜削成笔直结实的箭杆。坎德拉森林的箭一眼能认出：羽尾染蓝。据说每一支箭一辈子能命中十个目标。

Overhead were those same black birds -- Iron Beaks, I learned they were called -- and men mounted atop dragons, fearsome reptiles that breathed fire and swooped among the ash-clouds.

en: At the start of the first crusade, the western portion of Darien remains under control of the Order of Honor, while the eastern portion seethes in the clutches of the Council of Terror. Between them lie contested territories ripe for invasion. It is upon these volatile territories that players wage war. Each of the 313 territories across Darien has associated with it a particular Kingdoms map for players to compete on, with pre-assigned map restrictions and game launch parameters. Once one side or the other exceeds the victory conditions for ownership (described below), that territory falls under the control of the victorious side. At the same time, neighboring regions weakened by the shift in power find their lands suddenly contested by the warring armies.

zh: 小径在丘陵间绕了几天，后来林子稀成树和草，我就辨不清路了。不多时望见塔帕斯海，还有一片纯白的沙滩。从船上到丛林、从火里再回船上，我疑心自己是不是已经死了，到了阴间的贝壳宫。可转念一想：里尔的天堂若真有，总该多点吃食才对。

en: Even the most experienced guides and rangers seldom attempt the smallest peaks. en: Ferrix the Finder, the alleged author of the journal, is an apocryphal figure at best. In the many tales of Ferrix, he appears by turns as a heroic naval officer, a foolish dilettante, a dastardly scion of a noble family, or a humble scholar on a continuing quest for knowledge. It is interesting to note here, however, that in the dialect of the island of Greif and certain eastern portions of Aramon, the word "finder" can also be translated as "a bad man," "a scoundrel," or merely, "a thief."
zh: 这本手记据称出自「寻物者」费里克斯之手，可此人至多只是个真假难辨的传说。关于他的故事很多，他时而成了英勇的海军军官，时而是附庸风雅的蠢货，时而是名门里最不成器的子弟，又或者只是个为求学问四处奔走的谦和书生。有意思的是，在格里夫岛和阿拉蒙东部某些地方的土话里，「finder」一词也能解作「坏人」「无赖」，甚至干脆就是「小偷」。

en: As of today (12/8/99), the Crusades is in "open beta". This means anybody who logs on to Boneyards and clicks on the Crusades button will have the option of downloading the 30 megabytes of data required to play. Note: being a beta tester will most likely require multiple downloads…some may be large. It may mean having to do a "clean install" when something breaks. We're going to do our best to minimize such grief, but it only seems fair to warn you that beta software is called beta software for a reason. With all that said, I think you are really going to love the crusades. So check it out!
zh: 截至今日（12/8/99），达里恩远征仍处于「公开测试」阶段。也就是说，只要登录 Boneyards 点下远征按钮，就能下载所需的 30 MB 数据开玩。请注意：当测试员多半得反复下载……有的包还不小；出了岔子，可能还得「全新安装」一遍。我们会尽力少给大家添这种麻烦，不过有句话得说在前头：测试版之所以叫测试版，自有它的道理。话虽如此，我想你一定会喜欢上远征的。去看看吧！

en: However, from conversations in Meredoc's few inns, I learned in earlier times, the islands of Varro and Grief were once ruled by the nation of Aramon, and the Verunan navy has sailed more than a few times in support of the Berserker tribes to turn back the southern folk. These days, the islands populated mainly by common folk who make their living as fishermen and goatherders. It was probably for the better, as it seem highly unlikely we could have found an inn suitable for Horvino's delicate slumber, or a public house that serves the finest cuts of spiced beef.
zh: 不过在梅雷多克那几家客栈里闲谈，我听说早些年瓦罗和格里夫两岛曾归阿拉蒙管辖；为帮狂战士部族挡住南方人，维鲁纳海军可没少出航。如今岛上住的多是打鱼放羊的寻常人家。这样倒也好——真要再往前走，多半找不出一家配得上霍尔维诺那讲究睡法的客栈，也寻不着肯端上等香料牛肉的酒馆。

en: Our fair kingdom is both the most sizable and prosperous of the Four Realms. It is a land of green fields, crystalline lakes and magnificent mountains. From the Kuvera Straits to the Edamothi Sea, Aramon is unparalleled in natural beauty, and in the industry of its people. The people of Aramon are noteworthy for their ingenuity and skill at many trades. While they may lack the social graces and refinement of the worldly Verunans, they are friendly, outgoing and generous.
zh: 我们这美丽的王国，是四大疆域里幅员最广、也最富足的一处：绿野无垠，湖水澄澈，群山雄峻。从库维拉海峡到埃达莫西海，阿拉蒙的风物举世无双，百姓的勤勉也少有匹敌。阿拉蒙人心灵手巧，各行各业都拿得起。比起见惯世面、讲究仪态的维鲁纳人，他们许是少了些风雅，却热情、爽朗、慷慨。

By day, said Sculpin, the ship was followed by sharks, some longer than the ship's mast is tall, he said, and daring enough to bump the vessel itself. At night, ghostly lights would flit this way and that, and the crew could see many bonfires in the hills of Taros.

en: The Winner Takes All Ladder is quite similar in scope to the Duel Ladder. However, in a Winner Takes All match, players must face multiple opponents in an every-man-for-himself fight to the finish. These games offer the additional challenge of fighting against the combined might of several opponents. Tactics change drastically when a full assault against one opponent may leave you exposed to attack on other fronts.
zh: 「胜者通吃」榜的规矩与「对决」榜大体相仿，只是这一榜里，你得同时对付好几个人，各顾各、混战到最后一个站着。要顶住几路合力，比单挑更考本事：倾全力压向一人，别处门户便大开，打法一下子就全变了。

en: For a traveler emerging from the Moor, Waleph seems a snug paradise. Friendly folk greet travelers from the porches of their low-eaved homes, and the city inns provide much good food and drink. Waleph is also known for its fine leather goods -- Kaluen nobility and wealthy merchants are often seen in the field dressed in Waleph leather.

en: During play, you’ll wage war against your opponent no differently than you would a standard multiplayer game. During the game, the Boneyards server periodically stores current game information. When the game concludes, final scores, winners and losers, and other game information will be automatically recorded and applied to the ladder rankings. With Boneyards, all you have to do is play.
zh: 对局之中，你打你的仗，和普通多人游戏没两样。Boneyards 服务器会隔一阵存一次当前局面；一局终了，最终得分、胜负双方以及别的对局数据，都会自动记下并算进排行榜名次。用了 Boneyards，你只管打就是了。

en: In days, we had reached the rim of the Acid Bog, and for days afterward, the smell of the sulphur pots lingered in my hair. Among those badlands, we saw geysers of boiling water and lakes turned yellow and crusty. We were hungry much of the time, for few edible plants, animals or people lived here -- just the numerous insects that seemed to flourish in the boiling pools.

en: Of my father's brother, we saw not; Shekelesh itself had been ripped asunder by the madness of the Belial-worshippers. The men of the party furiously debated what to do. Some blamed Father for leading them north -- surely Ugarit was not as bad as this damned place, they said. Others wanted to drive east to the water and perhaps bargain for passage to the islands of Zakum and Siddhi. Zakum was rumored to be settled by those friendly to those escaping Taros, but Father said that could not be so, for it was not long ago that Baron Leimar had routed the Zakum people in a bloody conflict.
zh: 父亲的兄弟，我们终究没能见着；舍克勒什自己已被贝里尔信徒的疯狂撕成了两半。队里的男人争得不可开交。有人怪父亲把大家往北带——他们说，乌加里特再糟也糟不过这鬼地方。另一些人想往东直奔海边，说不定能商量搭船去扎库姆和悉迪。传闻扎库姆住着些愿意帮人逃离塔罗斯的人，父亲却说不可能：不久前莱玛尔男爵才在一场血战里把扎库姆人打垮。

en: Players join the Clash of Nations ladder simply by choosing it as the game type when hosting a game, or joining a game where Clash of Nations is selected. en: But I was frightened then, for the guards were Taros Executioners, with their long pole-blades that went snickety-snak. Cut you to pieces they would. But the Dark Priest that commanded them had a need for servants, and he singled out my family and some others. Soon I found myself within the castle walls, carrying jugs of wine and frothy beer to the Priest's table as he conferred with the nobles of Shekelesh. Can you imagine me, dressed in rags with a dirty, smudged face, while the noblemen and magicians tore apart hunks of pork and fowl and wiped their greasy fingers on long, dark tables of fine wood.
zh: 可那时我怕极了：守卫是塔罗斯行刑者，手里的长柄刃刀咔嚓作响，能把人剁成碎块。倒是统领他们的黑暗祭司正缺使唤的人，便从人群里挑中了我一家和另外几户。没多久，我就进了城堡，端着葡萄酒和泛沫的啤酒送上祭司的餐桌——他正与舍克勒什的贵族议事。你能想见吗：我衣衫褴褛、满脸污黑，贵族和术士们却撕着大块猪肉禽肉，把油手往名贵木料做的长条深色桌上一抹。

en: All was not lost for us. For in the chaos of the moment, we entered the city unchallenged. Quilp was not unlike Ugarit, a city of merchants and smiths, all of them speaking the Taros tongue. The first night we spent wandering, but Father soon found bedding in an empty stable, and later found work unloading ships on the nearby docks. And when the Verunans arrived to trade, we traveled with them to Lendra and then to Aramon.

en: While the Near-Men of northern Zhon were dirty and foul, the Kiniket were gentle, curious and kind. Pelts of straw, eyes of deep brown. They spoke the Zhon tongue with a lilting accent. Plied me with food, they did. Fruits and fishes, and a fine drink brewed of a grain they called sorat. Spent a fortnight among them; the Kiniket children seemed to especially like me for my beard, black hair and leather clothes.
zh: 佐恩北部的近人又脏又臭，基尼凯特人却温和、好奇、厚道：身披草编的罩衣，眼睛深褐。他们说佐恩话，尾音轻轻上扬。一个劲儿地拿吃的待我：果子、鱼，还有用他们叫「sorat」的谷子酿的好酒。我在他们那儿住了两周；基尼凯特的孩子格外喜欢我，大约是因为我的胡子、黑头发和那身皮衣。

en: The road ran along the foothills of the Lesser Kaf; Father told me these mountains were once called the Spine of Taros, for they near split the land in twain from north to south. It was the farthest I had ever been from Ugarit, and soon enough I could see evidence of the Necromancer's passing, for Lokken's magic had twisted and broken the very land itself. The smell of magic hung in the air; trees were bent and broken, oozing yellow pus. Cawing black birds abounded, each large enough to attack the horses. Farmers' fields were overtaken with biting, stinging insects, the likes of which no one had ever seen before.
zh: 路沿着小卡夫山的山脚往前伸。父亲说，这些山从前叫「塔罗斯之脊」，因为它们几乎把大地自北向南劈成两半。那是我离家最远的一回；没多久便看见了死灵法师路过的痕迹——洛肯的魔法连大地本身都扭折撕裂了。空气里浮着魔法的气味；树弯的弯、断的断，渗出黄脓。黑鸦聒噪，成群都是，只只大得能扑咬马匹。农人的田里尽是会咬会蜇的虫，谁也没见过那样的东西。

en: An annual summer event in Waleph is Fair-Day, a celebration that coincides with the summer solstice on the ancient Kandran calendar. The families of Waleph meet in the town center for a great feast, while bards and performers of all types meet to share stories and songs. However, Fair-Day's main events are horse races and other displays of riding ability. The proud young men who make up the city patrols train year-long for the contests; winners are awarded coin and other goods donated by the city families.
zh: 瓦尔菲普每年夏天有个「集市日」，正赶上古坎德兰历的夏至。城里各家聚到镇中心大摆筵席，吟游诗人和各式艺人凑在一处说故事、唱曲子。不过集市日最要紧的，还是赛马和各类骑术比试。担当城防巡队的年轻人一身傲气，为这些比赛整年操练；赢了的人，能领到城中各家捐出的钱币和物件。

en: After the long passage, the sight of land and the Verunan city of Vanoc sent a cheer through all three ships. Vanoc's younger folk rowed animal-skin outriggers to greet the ships, calling out to us in their peculiar, singsong accent. The island of Caora is truly Lihr's most beautiful work, with rocky cliffs giving way to beaches of black sand and tall graceful trees called marcas in the local dialect. My master and the rest of the party spent three full fortnights on the island, the first few days of which Horvino spent in a heady stupor from drinking prodigous quantities of moisina, a sweet drink made from marcas fruit juice and distilled spirits. My master is quite the trencherman, and is certainly developing a lordly belly!
zh: 漫长的航程之后，望见陆地与维鲁纳的瓦诺克城，三艘船上的人齐声欢呼。瓦诺克的年轻人划着兽皮小艇前来迎接，用他们那古怪而抑扬顿挫的腔调向我们打招呼。卡奥拉岛确是里尔最动人的造物：嶙峋的峭壁一路让位给黑沙滩，还有当地话叫「马卡斯」的高挑秀美的树。主人一行在岛上足足住了六个星期；头几天霍尔维诺狂饮莫西娜——用马卡斯果汁兑蒸馏酒调成的甜饮——醉得不省人事。我家主人可是个地道的饕餮，眼看要养出老爷肚了！

en: It is said that Dinlow's Ferry was originally named Dinlow's Point, and that the area takes its name from a rather comical story originating in days long past. Outside the city, at the very tip of the peninsula, stands a solitary lighthouse of grey-green stone, placed there to warn ships away from the lake's shallower waters and dangerous rocks nearby. The lighthouse itself stands at the end of a narrow jetty a half-mile long.

en: Reached the outskirts of Ulasem in a fortnight. Spied the buff stones of the mountain lair, then spent rest of day hiding. Saw ... things ... in evening light. Shapes silhouetted in camp fires. The map shows a trail leading from Basilisk Gate next day; found it ere the next sundown. From the Basilisk Gate to the Stone Graveyard, found the Upper Falls ... the cave was just as the map portrayed. The emerald. Takkawaw's Hand was there.

en: In developing their unprecedented Dynamic Battlefield Technology, the design team completely rewrote the meta-game rules, tapping their experience developing the Galactic War for Total Annihilation. Additional provisions include: Comprehensive algorithms for border influence modifiers between neighboring territories based on ownership; Intrinsic toughness levels for each territory; momentum factors based on recent victories; entrenchment bonuses for battles fought on territories after they've been conquered; and erosion and traffic modifiers that promise to make every battle fought count in a meaningful way, whether there are 500 or 5,000 people playing at any given time.
zh: 为做出前所未有的「动态战场技术」，设计团队把元游戏规则整个重写了一遍，借的是当年为《横扫千军》开发《银河战争》攒下的经验。新增的机制包括：按领土归属计算邻地边境影响力的完整算法；每块领土各自的固有韧性等级；依据近期胜绩的势头系数；在新征服领土上作战的据守加成；以及侵蚀与交通修正——不管同一时刻在线的是 500 人还是 5,000 人，这些修正都要让每一场仗都算得上数。

en: It is a heady task I shoulder, but it is a pleasure to celebrate the distinguished merit of my master, to whom I can only ascribe great excellence of character, name and taste. Some may call my master a naive boy, saying that he eats too much and belches too loudly. Others may call him a drunken boor, but I say only this: history shows us that great spirits have often encountered violent opposition from mediocre fellows.
zh: 这差事着实叫人飘飘然：替主人歌功颂德，是件快活事——他的品行、门第、眼光，样样都好得没话说。有人说主人是个天真孩子，嫌他吃得太饱、嗝打得太响；也有人骂他酒鬼粗汉。我只回一句：历来大人物，总免不了被庸人攻讦。

en: The ritual, however, turns quite serious the next day, as the men gather again to settle the challenges from the previous day. Barechested and wielding wooden clubs -- no weapon of steel is allowed -- they pummel each other until one either submits or is rendered unconscious. The matches continue until one man left; he is named Thane of Gwillion for the next year, and his wooden club becomes the symbol of his office. The newly crowned Thane must then honor the losing combatants with a grand feast and many toasts (In contrast to the Calling Out, at this celebratory feast it is considered good etiquette to praise an opponent's strength and skill).
zh: 到了第二天，仪式才真正动起真格：男人们重新聚齐，了结前一日留下的叫阵。他们赤着上身，手持木棒——不许用铁器——彼此对打，直到一方认输或被打昏。比试一场接一场，直到只剩最后一人；他便被立为来年的格威利昂领主，手中那根木棒也成了权位的信物。新领主随后要设盛宴、频频举杯，向落败的对手致意（与「叫阵」不同，在这场庆功宴上，称赞对手的力气与本事才是得体之举）。
